params.name: LDipole
params.desc: if false all dipoles are turned off.

params.name: D_Type()
params.desc: besides horizontal dipoles which bend in the x-plane vertical dipoles can be specified to bend the beam in the y-plane. coordinates of the first corner of a dipole. Two numbers, enclosed by brackets and separated by a comma, are to be given. The first number defines the horizontal or vertical (if D_type = ‘vertical’) coordinate, the second number defines the longitudinal coordinate. coordinates of the second corner of a dipole. Two numbers, enclosed by brackets and separated by a comma, are to be given. The first number defines the horizontal or vertical (if D_type = ‘vertical’) coordinate, the second number defines the longitudinal coordinate. coordinates of the third corner of a dipole. Two numbers, enclosed by brackets and separated by a comma, are to be given. The first number defines the horizontal or vertical (if D_type = ‘vertical’) coordinate, the second number defines the longitudinal coordinate. coordinates of the fourth corner of a dipole. Two numbers, enclosed by brackets and separated by a comma, are to be given. The first number defines the horizontal or vertical (if D_type = ‘vertical’) coordinate, the second number defines the longitudinal coordinate. taper parameter for the dipole fringe field. The first index of the array is 1 or 2 for the first and second dipole edge, while the second index refers to the dipole number.

params.name: D_radius()
params.desc: if a bending radius is defined the magnet strength is set during the tracking of the reference particle in accordance to the beam energy. If D_radius and D_strength are specified, D_radius has a higher priority.

params.name: D_xoff()
params.desc: transverse offset of the dipole in x.

params.name: D_yoff()
params.desc: transverse offset of the dipole in y.

params.name: D_zoff()
params.desc: longitudinal offset of the dipole in z.

params.name: D_xrot()
params.desc: rotation angle of the dipole in the x-z plane, i.e. around the y-axis.

params.name: D_yrot()
params.desc: rotation angle of the dipole in the y-z plane, i.e. around the x-axis.

params.name: D_zrot()
params.desc: rotation angle of the dipole around the z-axis, i.e. in the x-y plane.
